scope: Apple public company evidence from officially registered SEC sources and SIC V4; no addresses, officers or contact fields

text.meaning: Literal equality; case, whitespace, punctuation and leading zeroes remain significant.

integer-pad10.meaning: CIK decimal digits compared as an integer and rendered as ten-digit padding; use only on the explicitly configured CIK edge.

integer.meaning: SIC numeric code comparison removes a zero-only decimal suffix but preserves textual codes that are not plain integers; do not infer equivalence beyond this edge.

normalizationContract.scope: Modes are selected per relation; no implicit canonicalization across U2 attributes.

sic_reference.baseSql: SELECT item.class_id AS sic_code, item.class_desc AS description FROM company_dns.sic_codes_v4_raw LATERAL VIEW explode(data) AS item

relations.reason: Equality of the literal integer-looking and zero-padded strings; do not apply normalization implicitly
Canonical nonnegative integer key; leading zeroes removed locally; padded variants used only for the bounded lookup
Company SIC must exist in the reference; one-company sample only; does not establish description agreement

minimumDistinctExplanation: This universe has one observed company per raw source. Threshold 1 is explicit for these endpoint-shaped samples and is not a global coverage claim; U1 retains its minimum of 3.
